results.headline: Death toll tops 470 as barrier lake overflow halts Nepal-Bhutan rescue
results.reason: headline: says 'Nepal-Bhutan rescue' but every cited source describes the disaster as a Nepal-Tibet/Nepal-China border flood (e.g. A2, A6, A13); Bhutan appears in no cited source and contradicts the story's own summary, which correctly says 'Nepal-Tibet border'.

results.headline: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89; son Haakon takes throne
results.reason: Matches cited source articles (A4 confirms age, death location, succession, 35-year reign, Mette-Marit/Epstein correspondence, and son's rape conviction).

results.headline: Ratko Mladić, convicted of genocide at Srebrenica, dies in Hague prison
results.reason: summary: states the Srebrenica massacre killed 'at least 12,000 Muslims,' but cited sources (A115, A225, A358) consistently state 'at least 8,000 Muslims'; 12,000 appears in no cited source.

results.headline: US judge rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was illegal
results.reason: Matches cited sources: 59-page order (A8), Judge Rita Lin, First Amendment retaliation framing, first public supply-chain-risk designation of a US company, refusal to allow Claude for surveillance/autonomous weapons.

results.headline: Trump says Putin will not attack NATO as Pentagon prepares European defence options
results.reason: Matches cited sources: Trump downplaying Ratcliffe trip and saying Putin won't attack NATO (A410), and Colby's four-options-by-Nov-6/December-deadline NATO briefing (A39).

results.headline: Iran agrees to draw up Hormuz conditions list; US clears strait of mines
results.reason: why_it_matters: refers to 'a closure the Biden administration has so far failed to reverse,' but all cited sources describe the current Trump administration handling Iran policy (e.g. A41, A579, A462); Biden is not mentioned in any cited source and is a stale world-state assertion given the story's own Trump-era context.

results.headline: DRC launches Ebola vaccination drive as death toll reaches 2,744
results.reason: why_it_matters: claims 'renewed armed clashes in North Kivu have already forced three vaccination sites to suspend work,' but no cited source mentions North Kivu, armed clashes, or any suspended vaccination sites; the outbreak is described as centered in Ituri province with insecurity/displacement generally, not this specific claim.

results.headline: Syria appoints Kurdish commander Abdi as presidential adviser and allows Kurdish-language schooling
results.reason: Matches cited sources A36/A37: Abdi's appointment, SDF dissolution, Kurdish-language schooling decree, Turkey's wanted-terrorist listing and Interpol red notice, and Barrack's endorsement of the integration.

results.reason: Matches cited sources: Kyiv drone strikes/casualty and damage figures (A221), Kherson evacuation call and inability to intercept glide bombs/drones (A220).

results.reason: Matches cited source A505: business leaders possibly joining Xi's delegation and 'almost certain' truce extension.

results.headline: Bangladesh journalists jailed since 2024 remain detained as BNP fails to honour press-freedom pledge
results.reason: summary: says 'Five journalists and a writer' remain detained, but the cited source A581 names only 'Four Bangladeshi journalists ... and writer Shahriar Kabir' (four journalists plus one writer, five total), not five journalists plus a writer (six total) as the summary implies.

results.headline: Taiwan parliament passes its own drone plan and backs $7bn boost for domestic builders
results.reason: Matches cited sources: parliament rejecting the drone plan and passing its own (A456), and the $7bn drone-builder boost (A714).

results.headline: Australia severs ties with two Chinese universities as Pacific rivalry sharpens
results.reason: Matches cited source A495: ANU/Shandong University and University of Queensland partnerships cut, and the analyst's warning about Australian researchers being locked out of top-tier science.

results.headline: Trump chip tariff plan could cost $90bn in annual GDP and delay one-fifth of US data centre projects, industry warns
results.reason: summary: states the tariffs would 'delay or cancel most data centre projects planned through 2030,' but the cited source A47 states the CCIA estimate is 'about 20 percent' of data center projects delayed or canceled — a quantifier far stronger ('most') than the cited 'about 20 percent.'

results.headline: Fed chair Warsh's Jackson Hole debut scrutinised for rate signals as inflation persists above target
results.reason: summary: names 'Governors Michelle Bowman, Christopher Waller and Lisa Cook' as the dissenters favoring a rate hike, but cited sources only say 'three of them dissenting' (A29) or 'three Fed officials' (A423) without naming any individuals — an attribution upgrade from unnamed officials to named persons.

results.headline: Zambia opposition leader detained on treason charges ahead of president's inauguration
results.reason: summary: claims Mundubile 'finished second to incumbent President Hakainde Hichilema by fewer than 40,000 votes,' but neither cited source (A161, A577) states any vote margin; A161 only gives Hichilema's vote share as 'around 60%.'

results.headline: Japan's births rise for first time in 11 years
results.reason: summary: gives specific figures '731,000 babies born, a 1.8 percent increase the ministry attributed to a post-pandemic rebound in marriages,' but the sole cited source A289 has only a headline ('Japan's number of births rises for first time in 11 years') with no summary text or fulltext providing these figures or causal attribution — all specifics are unsupported.
